evals.prompt: I have a Capacitor app using @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning (Google ML Kit) for barcode scanning. I want to replace it with Scandit BarcodeCapture. Here is my scanner: MlkitScanner.ts
evals.expected_output: Removes the @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning APIs (BarcodeScanner.scan / startScan / addListener, BarcodeFormat) and adds a Scandit BarcodeCapture integration with the equivalent symbologies, preserving the ScannedProduct shape, the deduplication logic, and the summary rendering. Shows a setup checklist and a summary of changes.

assertions.text: @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning is NOT imported in the output code (it may appear in a before/after summary table)
BarcodeScanner.scan( is NOT called in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary table)
BarcodeScanner.startScan( is NOT called in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary table)
BarcodeFormat does NOT appear as an enum used in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary table)
await ScanditCaptureCorePlugin.initializePlugins() is present
DataCaptureContext.initialize( is present (v8 API)
DataCaptureContext.forLicenseKey( is NOT present
new BarcodeCapture(settings) is present (not BarcodeCapture.forContext)
context.setMode( is called to register the mode
Symbology.EAN13UPCA is enabled (maps the ML Kit Ean13 and UpcA formats)
Symbology.EAN8 is enabled (maps the ML Kit Ean8 format)
Symbology.Code128 is enabled (maps the ML Kit Code128 format)
Symbology.QR is enabled (maps the ML Kit QrCode format)
DataCaptureView.forContext( is present
view.connectToElement( is called
new BarcodeCaptureOverlay( is present
view.addOverlay( is called
barcodeCapture.addListener( registers a listener object with a didScan callback
session.newlyRecognizedBarcode is read inside didScan (semantic)
The ScannedProduct shape (value/format fields) is preserved in the output
The deduplication logic (checking the code does not already exist before adding) is preserved (semantic)
The renderSummary function and count-label update are preserved
Setup checklist mentions scandit-capacitor-datacapture-core and scandit-capacitor-datacapture-barcode packages
Setup checklist mentions npx cap sync
Setup checklist mentions iOS Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription
A summary of changes is shown describing what ML Kit APIs were removed and what Scandit APIs replaced them

evals.prompt: My Capacitor app (React) uses @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning for QR scanning and I want to switch to Scandit BarcodeCapture. The scanner helpers are in native-scanner.ts; the scan screen's own close button and layout live in other files and must keep working. Please migrate it.
evals.expected_output: Replaces the ML Kit helpers (installNativeScanner, getScanningStream, startScanning, stopScanning, scanSingle) with BarcodeCapture while keeping their exported signatures; the connected element has z-index -1 so the app's own HTML stays on top; stop turns the camera off, disables the mode and removes the listener; permission denial still throws; no formats were passed, so the default symbology set is enabled.

assertions.text: @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning is NOT imported in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
await ScanditCaptureCorePlugin.initializePlugins() is present and runs before DataCaptureContext.initialize(
new BarcodeCapture(settings) is used with context.setMode( (not BarcodeCapture.forContext)
barcodeCapture.addListener( registers a didScan callback that reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and skips a null barcode.data (semantic)
A summary of changes lists each judgment call (enabled symbologies, duplicate filter, overlay) and what was removed
The element passed to view.connectToElement( has a negative z-index (z-index: -1) so the native view sits UNDER the app's HTML (semantic)
connectToElement is called only after the element exists: React useEffect, after the container renders (semantic)
The exported helper names (installNativeScanner, getScanningStream, startScanning, stopScanning, scanSingle) are kept so callers do not change
The permission-denied path still reports an error and never fakes a granted state
installGoogleBarcodeScannerModule and isSupported are removed, not ported
stopScanning turns the camera Off, sets barcodeCapture.isEnabled = false and removes the listener

Symbology.QR is enabled and the enabled set is NOT narrowed below what the original scanned (the original passed no formats, so the recommended default set (QR, EAN-13/UPC-A, EAN-8, UPC-E, Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, ITF, Codabar, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417) is enabled)

evals.prompt: My Ionic React wallet scans QR codes with @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning in Scan.tsx (types in Scan.types.ts). Replace it with Scandit BarcodeCapture. The title, paste-content button and denied-permission screen must keep working, and the front/back camera prop must still work.
evals.expected_output: Migrates Scan.tsx to BarcodeCapture: the view is connected to its own element with z-index -1 (not the container that holds the title and paste button), the scan-active body class is kept, the cameraDirection prop keeps working through CameraPosition, the app's permission check and denied UI are kept, and stopScan tears everything down.

assertions.text: @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning is NOT imported in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
await ScanditCaptureCorePlugin.initializePlugins() is present and runs before DataCaptureContext.initialize(
new BarcodeCapture(settings) is used with context.setMode( (not BarcodeCapture.forContext)
barcodeCapture.addListener( registers a didScan callback that reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and skips a null barcode.data (semantic)
A summary of changes lists each judgment call (enabled symbologies, duplicate filter, overlay) and what was removed
The element passed to view.connectToElement( has a negative z-index (z-index: -1) so the native view sits UNDER the app's HTML (semantic)
connectToElement is called only after the element exists: React useEffect, after the container renders (semantic)

The cameraDirection / lensFacing behaviour is kept: LensFacing.Front maps to CameraPosition.UserFacing and LensFacing.Back to CameraPosition.WorldFacing (e.g. Camera.atPosition or Camera.asPositionWithSettings)
The title, paste-content button and paste modal are preserved and not covered by the native view
The permission-denied UI (no-permission class, scan.permissionalert text) is kept and is not replaced by a faked granted state
The body class scan-active is still added while scanning and removed on stop
Symbology.QR is enabled and the enabled set is NOT narrowed below what the original scanned (the original scanned QR only, so QR only is acceptable; narrowing a source that scanned more is not)

evals.prompt: My Angular + Ionic app scans a QR code in qr-form.component.ts with @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning. Migrate it to Scandit BarcodeCapture.
evals.expected_output: Migrates the Angular component: the DataCaptureView element is connected after the Angular view exists (ngAfterViewInit) with z-index -1, the scanner-active body class is kept, the first result is emitted and scanning is then stopped (camera Off, mode disabled, view detached), and ngOnDestroy tears the scanner down.

assertions.text: @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning is NOT imported in the new code (it may appear in a before/after summary)
await ScanditCaptureCorePlugin.initializePlugins() is present and runs before DataCaptureContext.initialize(
new BarcodeCapture(settings) is used with context.setMode( (not BarcodeCapture.forContext)
barcodeCapture.addListener( registers a didScan callback that reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and skips a null barcode.data (semantic)
A summary of changes lists each judgment call (enabled symbologies, duplicate filter, overlay) and what was removed
The element passed to view.connectToElement( has a negative z-index (z-index: -1) so the native view sits UNDER the app's HTML (semantic)

new BarcodeCapture(settings) is used with context.setMode( (not BarcodeCapture.forContext)
barcodeCapture.addListener( registers a didScan callback that reads session.newlyRecognizedBarcode and skips a null barcode.data (semantic)
